_note: Argos Maps PRODUCT matrix (plan.md item 29). Source: our notes from argosatlas.com/en/pricing/ read in a normal browser on 2026-11-24 (public page; their map itself is behind a sign-in wall, so nothing here is guessed from inside it). Our own words, no copied text. 'argos' = what they say is free or paid. 'gev' = what the GEV map already does (UNVERIFIED unless marked, from README and layer names). 'us' = our site today. verdict = three tests (Helpful, Gain, HCU) plus the hard rules. status: edge (we are already better), parity (same), gap (they have it, we do not), skip (fails a test or a hard rule, reason given).

rows.argos: free with a daily quota and an ad before a camera opens; Pro removes both
rows.gev: CCTV layer shows camera dots and opens the official source
rows.us: every camera is a link to its official page, no quota, no ad before the click, no sign-in
rows.verdict: Beats Argos by: no quota, no sign-in, official source, health stamp per camera

rows.argos: about 226,000 claimed on their live counter
rows.verdict: coverage queue data/world-coverage.json and plan items 28 and 30

rows.feature: Recording and 24 h history of cameras (paid, from DISTRICT)
rows.argos: paid: keeps the last 24 hours of chosen cameras, video scrub, timelapse, clips
rows.verdict: fails the link-out-only rule (storing pictures) and each operator's terms; never built

rows.feature: Videowall and TV mode, 16 cameras at once (paid, DIVISION)
rows.us: /saved/ lists your saved cameras as links
rows.verdict: showing 16 pictures at once is image embedding; our /saved/ list stays link-only

rows.feature: Camera API: embed any camera on your own site (paid)
rows.verdict: embedding or proxying pictures is barred (CLAUDE.md hard rule)

rows.gev: yes, the Cesium globe is the GEV default
rows.verdict: Beats Argos by: free 3D globe; watch the Cesium ion credit before ads (plan item 25)

rows.gev: yes, via OpenSky, adsb.lol and AIS routes
rows.us: routes closed: OpenSky needs a 99 USD a month licence, AISStream needs a key
rows.verdict: plan items 19, 20, 22: military aircraft open (adsb.lol), civil flights and ships wait on licence or key

rows.feature: Flight and ship history (7 to 90 days, paid)
rows.gev: aircraft tracks exist for the live session
rows.verdict: needs stored raw data (OpenSky bars long-term archives) and does not help someone looking for a camera

rows.feature: Alerts and daily brief by Telegram, Discord, Slack or email (paid)
rows.verdict: Helpful for a commute ('my camera is down'), but needs accounts or a backend, which our rules bar; revisit only with a serverless, no-account design after launch data

rows.gev: Authoring tools can draw areas (UNVERIFIED how far)
rows.verdict: alerts need a backend; the drawing part, if GEV has it, is free inside /map/

rows.feature: Your own ADS-B antenna on the map (paid)
rows.argos: paid, RTL-SDR over USB or a dump1090 address, decoded in the browser
rows.gev: GEV lists an RTL-SDR dependency (@jtarrio/webrtlsdr): likely present (UNVERIFIED)
rows.verdict: free for everyone if confirmed; check in a browser

rows.feature: AI assistant that drives the map (paid credits)
rows.gev: voice and chat need our paid OpenAI or Gemini keys
rows.us: routes closed so anonymous visitors cannot burn our keys
rows.verdict: open only behind a per-visitor cap or login (plan item 22 d)

rows.feature: CSV, GeoJSON and KML export (coming, paid)
rows.verdict: Helpful and Argos charges for it; needs a licence read per source for redistribution of the list, then a free download per city or road; plan item 29 follow-up, WAITING on licence reads

rows.feature: API and MCP server (AGENCY, 4,999 USD a month)
rows.gev: GEV has an MCP tool but /mcp is never allowed
rows.verdict: a bulk data API risks the redistribution terms of our sources and needs a backend

rows.argos: paid; the free site shows ads
rows.us: ads planned beside data only, never inside the map; the footer claim 'No ads' must change the day ads go in
rows.verdict: revenue is the point; ads beside data only

rows.argos: their map page asks for an account (Google or an emailed code) before anything loads
rows.verdict: Beats Argos by: also crawlable and shareable without an account

rows.feature: Geopolitics layers: conflicts, markets, VIPs, risk zones, power plants, news
rows.argos: free atlas counters: 1,661 events, 15,583 assets, 1,594 people, 221 risk zones, 34,936 power plants
rows.gev: many layers (power plants, EONET events, GDELT-based news closed)
rows.us: partly inside /map/; own news block failed the Helpful test (plan item 21)
rows.verdict: only the layers with a clean licence, and only if Search Console shows demand (plan item 27)
